tasks.title: Fill an offer from a JSON file
tasks.prompt: Fill the Word template offer.docx with the data in data.json (the "logo" field names the image file logo.png next to it). Write the result to offer-anna.docx.

tasks.title: Fill an offer from a description in words
tasks.prompt: Fill offer.docx for a new customer and write offer-jan.docx. Offer number 2026/12/007, dated 1 December 2026, for Jan Wiśniewski of Wiśniewski Meble. Two lines: 3 office chairs at 349.99 EUR each (1049.97 EUR in total) and 1 oak desk at 1200 EUR. The sum is 2249.97 EUR. He is not a VIP. Notes: "Delivery in 10 working days." Prepared by Anna Nowak. Use logo.png as the logo.

tasks.title: Fill an offer with Polish number and date formats
tasks.prompt: Fill offer.docx with data.json, but with Polish formatting of numbers, currencies and dates. Write offer-pl.docx.

tasks.title: Insert a Markdown summary
tasks.prompt: Fill offer.docx with data.json, but replace the notes with a short formatted summary: a bold sentence "Delivery is free." followed by a bulleted list of three items: "Assembly included", "Two-year warranty", "Payment within 14 days". Keep the template's own list style. Write offer-notes.docx.

tasks.title: Fill an offer with items from a CSV file
tasks.prompt: Fill offer.docx with data.json, but take the items from items.csv (name, qty, price in EUR; the total of a line is qty × price, and the sum is the total of all lines). Write offer-csv.docx.

tasks.title: Find what is wrong with the data
tasks.prompt: Check whether data-bad.json has everything offer.docx needs, without filling the template. Write every problem, one per line, with the name of the field, to problems.txt.

tasks.title: Describe the data a template needs
tasks.prompt: Find out which data offer.docx needs and write it as a JSON Schema to schema.json.

tasks.title: Find the problems in a template
tasks.prompt: The Word template broken.docx has mistakes in its tags. List each mistake with where it is in the document (paragraph) to problems.txt.

tasks.title: Fill a template with loops, conditions and formatters
tasks.prompt: Fill template.docx with data.json and write result.docx.

tasks.title: Fill headers, footers and footnotes
tasks.prompt: Fill template.docx with data.json, including its header, footer, footnote and endnote, and write result.docx.

tasks.title: A presentation with a slide per product
tasks.prompt: Fill the PowerPoint template deck.pptx with data.json, repeating the product slides once for each product, with their notes and photos. Write deck-filled.pptx.

tasks.title: Speaker notes for each product
tasks.prompt: Fill deck.pptx with data.json and write deck-notes.pptx; every product slide must keep its speaker notes filled for that product.

tasks.title: A workbook with a row per item and correct totals
tasks.prompt: Fill the Excel template sheet.xlsx with data.json: one row per item, keeping the formulas, so that the totals below the items add up all items. Write sheet-filled.xlsx.

tasks.title: A workbook with no items
tasks.prompt: Fill sheet.xlsx with data.json, but with an empty list of items and no notes. Write sheet-empty.xlsx without any tag left.

tasks.title: Check a result without an office application
tasks.prompt: Fill offer.docx with data.json into offer-anna.docx, then read the text of offer-anna.docx and write the customer's company and the sum, as written in the document, to check.txt.

variants.tplvane: Use the npm package tplvane (and its tplvane command line if you like).
variants.docxtemplater: Use the npm package docxtemplater, its free open-source core only, without paid modules.
